long_biography.plain_text:
Bringing international development banks and later Mitsubishi into Intercity changed how Vural Ak managed the company. He credits the partnership with imposing long-term planning, strict balance-sheet discipline and careful control of debt. When Mitsubishi exited emerging markets, he bought its stake and restored local ownership.

At Istanbul Park, Ak combined his longstanding interest in motor racing with event management, helping return Formula One to Turkey during the pandemic. He also established Akyacht after failing to find a local hangar large enough for a custom project. The shipyard was designed from the outset for unusually large builds, turning a practical constraint into a separate manufacturing business.
